arStrings.szText: Your {c_important}Enchantments{/c} are {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|%|]{/c} stronger, and each equipped {c_important}Enchantment{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_1} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage with their main element, and {c_number}[{SF_2} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for the second {c_important}Enchantment{/c} if it is the same element.
